snippet.title: Super Blowfish Castle - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Physics are your best frenemy in this cozy chaotic puzzle-solving platformer where you guide a small blowfish back to its castle just by pressing one button. Maximize your skills and test your patience as you guide a small blowfish back to its castle through a bunch of crazy obstacles. The only thing you have to do is press one button. It's pretty much a cutesy mixture of Super Monkey Ball and Getting Over It with Bennet Foddy.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2429460/Super_Blowfish_Castle/
